overview.description: The WisdomTree Equity Premium Income Fund (WTPI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index that consists of short SPY put options and cash collateral. The index selects put options that target a premium of 2.5% and rolls its exposure twice a month. WTPI was launched on Feb 24, 2016 and is issued by WisdomTree.
